column1: # K-Line Dash: Ford (petrol PCM) manufacturer-specific trouble code meanings
#   - description: our own short wording of the Ford meaning of a P1xxx code.
#   - note: a short first check, only where sources widely agree; empty otherwise.
# Curated selection, not an import. A code is listed only if at least two separate publications agree on
# its meaning and none disagrees; codes where sources disagreed were left out. Diesel-specific codes,
# transmission codes and the US fuel pump driver module family were not taken.
# Sources (separate sites; all reproduce Ford's OBD-II diagnostic code chart, so they share one origin):
#   OC  https://www.obd-codes.com/trouble_codes/ford/ (the carcarehacks.com Ford list is a copy, counted once)
#   TC  troublecodes.net, entries labelled Ford/Lincoln/Mercury: https://www.troublecodes.net/p1codes/
# Ford's European petrol PCMs share the EEC-V lineage of this list; EU diesel (TDCi) ECUs do not.
